query: What are the main kinds of issues these support tickets are about?

per_column.name: issue_category
per_column.rationale: Directly answers the query about kinds of issues; provides a clean grouping axis with well-differentiated categories. Values are sound readings of the source text (billing_issue for invoice duplicate, outage_incident for 502, feature_request for enhancement). Minor debatability: CS-0002 session drop labeled 'bug' when the customer suspects an SSO config push, but it is a defensible reading.

per_column.name: primary_product_area
per_column.rationale: Gives a genuine second axis (product area) to cross-tabulate issue kinds, useful for the analysis. Values are well-grounded: billing_payments, authentication_identity, infrastructure_platform, user_interface, data_integrity all map cleanly to the described text.

per_column.name: root_cause_mechanism
per_column.rationale: Useful root-cause axis and correctly uses 'not_present' for silent rows (feature request). However several values assert mechanisms the text does not support: CS-0001 labeled configuration_error though text only describes a duplicate line item; CS-0003 labeled resource_exhaustion when a 502 could stem from many causes and the text is silent; CS-0002 configuration_error where the customer only 'suspects' an SSO push. Confident specifics on silent rows lower groundedness.

per_column.name: resolution_action_type
per_column.rationale: Adds an actionable axis (what fix is needed) that is not redundant with category. Mostly warranted inferences (feature_implementation for enhancement, urgent_incident_response for outage, billing_credit_audit for invoice fix). Slightly speculative since tickets describe problems not resolutions, but the inferred action types are reasonable projections of the request.

judge.rationale: All four columns give distinct, non-redundant analytical axes (issue kind, product area, root cause, resolution action) that meaningfully support answering what the tickets are about and how they cluster. Groundedness is strong for issue_category and product_area, but weaker for root_cause_mechanism where several confident specific causes are asserted on rows where the source text is silent or only speculative. Correct use of 'not_present' for silent rows is noted positively.
